narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>The diagonal of a square makes a triangle with two equal sides and a right angle.
<bookmark mark='two'/>It cuts each corner it reaches into two equal angles.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. In square P Q R S, the diagonals cross at O. Find angle O P Q and angle P O Q.
